summary: Phase E item 4 (Marketplace Events) — ticketed events with limited capacity — fully verified on shared backend, web (RadioLife overlay) and mobile (Expo). Backend pytest 13/13 pass covering merchant CRUD (list w/ tickets_sold/remaining/sold_out, create/update/delete, 404 event_not_found on unknown, patch capacity_below_sold rejected), consumer flows (business_events shape w/ items+mine+points_balance+points_per_dollar=100, business_detail.has_events=true, unknown event 404, bad_method 400, free-event points purchase issues ticket immediately with points_spent=0), CAPACITY ENFORCEMENT (buying up to cap succeeds, next 400 sold_out; sold_out flag reflected in consumer listing), no-oversell (qty>remaining is atomic 400 sold_out, tickets_sold stays 0), card purchase returns Stripe checkout_url + cs_ session_id and reserves capacity immediately, /events/purchase/{sid}/status returns pending, unknown session 404 purchase_not_found. Web /shop/merchant/events (rl-merchant-events-page + all mevt-* form/edit/del testIDs) creates event end-to-end via UI; /shop/events/biz_8484f6f985d5 renders rl-shop-events-page + evt-*, evt-remaining-*, evt-qty-*/plus/minus, evt-buy-points-*, and evt-mine + evt-ticket-* after purchase. Entry links merchant-open-events (/shop/merchant) and shop-detail-event (/shop/{biz}) both render. Mobile parity confirmed: mevt-root + all form testIDs + mevt-item on /merchant/events; evt-root + evt-{eid} + remaining/qty/plus/minus/buy-points on /shop/events/[id]; merchant-open-events on /merchant/dashboard; shop-detail-event on /shop/[id]. No critical or minor bugs detected. Full parity across web+mobile.
critical_code_review_comments: marketplace_events.purchase_ticket card path hardcodes currency='usd' — same pattern as memberships/giftcards/packages; consider deriving from business/market for internationalization.
purchase_status Stripe.retrieve is called on every poll; no rate-limit guard. Fine at current scale.

_reserve() atomicity is guaranteed by the {tickets_sold: {$lte: capacity-qty}} guard, but it does two DB round-trips (find_one + update_one). The initial find_one is only used to short-circuit missing events; a single update_one with the same guard against a filter matching {event_id, active:true} could remove the extra read (still atomic).

Consumer response includes ticket 'code' in /businesses/{id}/events mine list and in the purchase response — anyone who has read access to a listener's account also sees active tickets by code. Consider only returning full code once at purchase and short/redeem code at scan time.

There is no path yet to redeem/mark a ticket 'used' from the merchant side (unlike packages.redeem). If venues need scan-to-verify, plan a merchant redeem endpoint that transitions status active->used.
test_credentials: Web: POST /api/auth/demo cookie (demo@bigfm.dubai). Mobile: demo-login-btn on /login (bearer stored in localStorage key 'bigfm_session_token').
seed_data_creation: Tests create+delete throwaway TEST_evt_* / WEB*_* / MOB*_* events against demo's biz_8484f6f985d5. Every success path is followed by DELETE. However, a few tickets purchased in the capacity/no-oversell / free / capsold tests are left in event_tickets for the demo user (tickets accumulate under 'Your tickets' on the demo consumer page). This is expected — event_tickets is not cleaned to keep the API idempotent — but the parent events are deleted, so tickets show only in /events/mine (they no longer appear under a business unless that business has more active events created later).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Events phase is stable end-to-end. Backend capacity/sold-out/no-oversell/atomic increment, points/card purchase, ticket issuance, and all entry links are in place on both surfaces. Notes for next agent: (1) The consumer web /shop/events/{biz} page inside RadioLife layout has a bottom nav (LISTEN/SHOP/PAY/REWARDS/PROFILE). When Playwright clicks 'evt-buy-points-*' via CSS-hit-test on some viewports the click can be intercepted by the fixed bottom PAY tab, producing an unexpected navigation to /pay — mitigate by scrolling the button fully into view and dismissing the cookie banner, or drive the API directly (see WEBMINE_ test in this iteration for verification). This is a test-artifact, not a product bug. (2) Mobile fetch from the Expo web preview must use absolute URL against EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL — the preview host does not proxy /api. (3) demo user carries a stack of stale event_tickets from prior iterations, which is fine — 'Your tickets' area will just look cluttered visually. (4) PRD next: Phase E item 5 — Multi-Merchant Cart. (5) See critical_code_review_comments for a couple of hardening improvements (single-round-trip reserve, ticket code exposure, redeem/scan flow).
